_archive: V2 state archived to .harness/state-v2-archive.json. V2 final: D1=0.72 D3=0.31 (n=50), JIRA injection brought D3=0.35 on n=20.
vision: Build a plan-driven bug attribution agent with internal governance. The system separates concerns into three pipelines: (1) Input Pipeline — deterministic extraction and candidate retrieval at zero LLM cost; (2) Agent Pipeline — LLM plans, examines, and attributes within an InvestigationBrief, governed by an investigation harness with rules and skills; (3) Evaluation Pipeline — oracle scores output. The agent receives a CandidateSet (not raw repo access), operates within completion criteria (not just budget), produces structured InvestigationTraces for learning, and improves over time via skills derived from traces. Evaluated via Hit@k, MRR, D3, D6, and Retrieval Recall against ApacheJIT ground truth.
direction: ARCHITECTURE V4.2: Revised Hierarchical Pipeline. Separates narrowing from deep investigation: script pre-score (100→15) → deterministic triage (15→7: 3 must-examine + 4 watchlist, zero LLM) → scoped investigation (ReAct) → conditional watchlist expansion. Phase 1b simplified to deterministic tier assignment after triage smoke test showed TriageRecall@7=1.00 with pre-score rank alone. ADR: .harness/docs/v42-architecture-adr.md. NFRs: .harness/docs/architecture-constraints.md.

invariants.temporal_bound: Temporal bound (COMMIT_B~1) constrains the ENTIRE system — input pipeline retrieval and agent tools. In eval mode, bound comes from fix_hash. In production mode (future), from bug report date or HEAD.
invariants.llm_reasons_scripts_retrieve: Scripts own retrieval (candidate set assembly) and evidence verification. LLM owns planning, examination reasoning, and attribution. The LLM never searches from scratch — it receives a curated CandidateSet.
invariants.agent_is_governed: The investigation harness governs the LLM. The LLM does not self-govern. The harness manages state, transitions, and completion criteria. Budget is a hard stop, not the primary exit signal.
invariants.observable_by_design: Every investigation produces a structured InvestigationTrace. No investigation is a black box. Traces are the substrate for skill emergence.
invariants.ground_truth: GroundTruthGraph provides bug_hash from commit_links.csv. SZZ-based labeling has known noise -- Hit@5 is primary metric, not Hit@1.

tasks.name: V4.2 pre-implementation gate: Recall@15 ablation
tasks.scope: Run pre-score formula (0.5·file_overlap + 0.3·norm(signal_count) + 0.2·(1-norm(best_rank))) on n=20 eval cases with oracle. Measure Recall@15 per case. Must pass: GT in top 15 on >=80% of retrievable cases (>=6/8 where Recall@100=true). Test weight sensitivity.

misses: IGNITE-1787 (rank 29, single strategy, low file overlap)
result.note: Multi-hash SZZ check (all bug_hashes per fix). Recall@100 rises from 8/20 (single-hash) to 13/20 (multi-hash). Default weights (0.5/0.3/0.2) confirmed.

tasks.name: V4.2 pre-implementation gate: provider + tool-block compliance
tasks.scope: Fix provider priority chain (OpenAI first for eval, add DISABLE_CURSOR_SDK). Run n=3 scoped eval on OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-4o or sonnet via proxy).
